idea-plugin.name: Claude Code ACP Bridge (Subscription)
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a Claude Code (Subscription) agent to JetBrains AI chat that authenticates with a Claude.ai Pro/Max subscription, and keeps the underlying ACP adapter up to date from inside the IDE.

The Claude agent bundled with the IDE is launched with --hide-claude-auth, which removes the subscription auth method and rejects subscription credentials at session start with "This integration does not support using claude.ai subscriptions".

This plugin installs the official @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp adapter into its own directory and registers it as a local agent without that flag. Nothing is patched: the package supports subscriptions by default. It also polls the npm registry for new adapter versions and can install them without restarting the IDE.

Credits. The adapter doing the actual work is @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp (Apache-2.0, by Anthropic, Zed Industries and JetBrains). It is downloaded from npm on your machine rather than bundled here. This plugin is derived from vanssata/jetbrains-claude-subscription (MIT).
Requires Node.js 22+ and the JetBrains AI Assistant plugin.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or JetBrains.
